plan.name: Use toaster to heat egg
plan.strategy: Use the toaster to heat the egg, then place it in the garbage can.
steps: Find an egg in the fridge or on the countertops.
Take the egg to the toaster.
Place the egg in the toaster and heat it.
Retrieve the heated egg from the toaster.
Put the heated egg into the garbage can.
